proposal.title: Rows stay open, clean lines
proposal.direction: r006-02 with the line fix the user circled: during a fold or unfold, the empty cells of an evidence row (the other products' columns when a single card is open) no longer show a teal vertical line. The animation's clipping wrapper made them count as non-empty, which switched on the open card's teal rule; empty cells are now left unwrapped, and each cell's rules are read before wrapping. Everything else as r006-02: rows already unfolded stay unfolded, highlights fade with the motion, hover waits while rows resize.
